24.original: Gather prophetic stones from Pike Falls.

25.original: Deliver the prophetic stones to the Ananta whispermaid.

48.original: The Velodyna Gatekeepers have done excellent work thus far monitoring our borders, but Alpa fears they grow complacent for lack of any serious threatsss.

49.original: In the hopesss of motivating them, I thought we might revive one of the Ananta's more ancient traditions─divinationsss.

50.original: To divine the fortunes of war, custom dictates one versssed in its art gather three precious stones required for the ritual. I can think of none better than you for this task.

51.original: When you have procured the gems we require, deliver them to the Ananta whissspermaid.

52.original: To read the fortunes of war I require three prophetic ssstones. No more, no lesss. Bring them to me and all shall be revealed.

53.original: You are returned. Have you the prophetic ssstones I require?

54.original: These shall do nicely. Now, let us sssee what the future holds for the Velodyna Gatekeepers.

56.original: Great peril awaits in the days ahead. Calamity born from carelessness. They would do well not to lose focusss lest this future come to pass.

57.original: Ah! I see great successs for the Gatekeepers! The efforts of their training shall be returned three─nay, four-fold!

58.original: Ahem. My apologies. 'Tis not often fortune sssmiles so favorably upon us.

59.original: Ah! Great fortune awaits the Gatekeepers! An unexpected windfall for the benefit of all!

60.original: Ahem. Forgive me. It has been too long since fortune has sssmiled upon us so favorably.

61.original: Hmmm... The future is riddled with uncertainty, but I sssense the potential for discord within our ranksss. Geniality is more important now than ever.

62.original: I foresee a fortuitous meeting. Newly formed ties should be treated with the greatessst of care. In doing so we shall not want for allies in times of strife.

63.original: The power of the stones is spent, and thusss the vision ends.

64.original: I would stay, but my sisters in Vira Nilya have need of my insssight. Pray tell Eshana what I have seen.

65.original: Welcome back, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. What did she have to say of our future? What fortune awaitsss the Gatekeepers?

66.original: Interesting... I will make certain my sssisters hear of this and act accordingly. The word of a whissspermaid is not to be taken lightly.

67.original: Though not always clear, their divinations remain in our thoughts, guiding our actions in the hopes of a desirable outcome. I daresay you too would do well to adhere to her words. It may prove to your benefit.
